name: @obsidianasecmx/obsidiana-client
description: JavaScript client library for encrypted HTTP and WebSocket communication using the Obsidiana protocol. Automatically performs handshake (PoW + ECDSA + ECDH), encrypts all requests with AES‑GCM‑256, and runs cryptographic operations in a Web Worker (or worker_threads) to keep the main thread responsive.
author: Kevin Huerta <kevinhuerta2808@gmail.com>
